newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Earthquake hits Philippines, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits Philippines, no damage reported.

text.p: A moderate earthquake shook the Philippine tourist resort of Puerta Galera, south of Manila on Wednesday night, but there were no reports of damage, government seismologists said on Thursday.
The tremor, measuring 5.9 on the Richter scale, was the second quake in the Philippines in less than 24 hours.
A 7.0 magnitude earthquake hit the southern Mindanao island before dawn on Wednesday and caused a fire in Cagayan de Oro City. However, no casualties were reported.

"We have not received any report of damage and we are not expecting any," Emmanuel Ramos, deputy director at the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) said, referring to the latest quake.
The epicentre of the Wednesday night quake was offshore 14 km (9 miles) northeast of Puerto Galera and 111 km (69 miles) southwest of Manila.
The institute said aftershocks may be expected.
